hypothesised_pattern: The base model misses an even effect of x4 (higher target at larger |x4|), and also a possible x4-x5 interaction in which moderately negative x4 combined with large positive x5 raises the target.
rationale: Positive residuals include large |x4| of both signs (-2.29, -1.42, 2.18) and a cluster with x4 of about -0.5 to -0.77 paired with x5 of 1.33-2.29 (product about -1).
